text:
Victor Eklund is listed at 5'11" and 175 pounds, and he has 70 hits in 23 games. That alone says a lot about the Islanders' 16th overall pick from 2025, the younger brother of San Jose's William Eklund. "That guy gives you everything every night. He's as honest a player as we have on the roster," Peter DeBoer said, as relayed by NHL.com's Stefen Rosner. The rookie also has 7 goals and 11 points, and Yahoo Sports says the Calder attention is earned.

Some of the scoring is running ahead of the play. He's shooting 20.6%, above the 14.3% our numbers think he can sustain, and with him on at five on five the Islanders have only 46.1% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) while scoring 10.3 more goals than those chances deserve. That is luck going his way. His own chance creation, 0.92 expected goals per 60, is solid for a 20-year-old, and his minutes are rising, 15.74 a night over his last ten. The Elmonters report a move up the lineup to play with his idol. Our numbers project about 43 points.
headline: Victor Eklund hits like he's twice his size
